name: liketypeless
description: Local-first Windows voice input, text structuring, and translation assistant.

scripts.dev:desktop: npm --workspace @liketypeless/shared run build && npm --workspace apps/desktop run dev
scripts.check: npm --workspace @liketypeless/shared run check && npm --workspace @liketypeless/desktop run check
scripts.check:api: cd apps/local-api && python -m compileall app scripts
scripts.dist: npm run build:icon && npm run build:licenses && npm run build:backend && npm --workspace @liketypeless/shared run build && npm --workspace apps/desktop run dist
scripts.test:smoke: npm --workspace apps/desktop run build && node evals/tests/desktop-smoke.mjs
scripts.eval:fixture: python evals/scripts/run_text_regression.py --manifest evals/fixtures/text-regression.jsonl --output evals/predictions/ci-text.jsonl && python evals/scripts/evaluate.py --manifest evals/fixtures/text-regression.jsonl --predictions evals/predictions/ci-text.jsonl --output evals/reports/ci-text.json
